question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"to deliver"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In** Line 1 **of the given passage, Narrator told that he was often invited to colleges and universities **to address** lectures.
 
• Let us explore the **given options** and** choose our answer **which can fit **'to address' **in our blank.
 
• **Infinitives **are commonly used to indicate an action that is expected to happen. It is generally formed by adding **'to'** before **'V1'.**
 
• ** To deliver (to +V1)** : is used to make a speech, to address, to give a lecture etc to a lot of people__.
 
 
• **Example**: *He had been due **to deliver** a lecture on ' corporate responsibility'.*
 
 
 
• Thus, looking at the above example and the explanation given above, the word which will fill the **blank number 1 is "to deliver".**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2).**

**Correct Passage: ***I was often invited to colleges and universities **to deliver** lectures. Once, I went to a university to deliver a lecture. (2) ______ it was over, the students gathered to ask (3) ______questions. Though it was getting late (4) ______ for my next programme, since I love talking to(5) ______, I remained there answering their questions.*
